articles.title: Goldman Sachs CEO backs ‘not perfect’ CLARITY Act as vote expected soon
articles.snippet: Goldman chief David Solomon will support the crypto market structure bill now in Congress, even as financial companies and banks are hesitant over provisions on stablecoins.

articles.title: Home invasions became most common crypto wrench attack in H1 2026: CertiK
articles.snippet: Crypto home invasions rose to 20 in H1 2026 from one a year earlier, while France accounted for 33 of 52 verified wrench attacks, according to CertiK.

articles.title: Crypto 'Wrench Attacks' Cost Victims $124M in Six Months, Up 12x: CertiK
articles.snippet: Physical attacks on crypto holders are increasingly happening at home, and France has become the epicenter, a new report finds.

articles.title: Pakistan Launches Crypto Investigation Unit to Fight Money Laundering
articles.snippet: Islamabad is building the enforcement side of its crypto push, standing up a unit to police money laundering even as it licenses exchanges.
